name: Student Accident/Injury Report
description: Student accidents or injuries at school are promptly reported to the principal and documented, and the school nurse is informed whenever nursing care is needed.
recipient: Building principal or designee; school nurse
quote: In the event that a student is involved in an accident or is injured at school, such accidents/injuries shall be promptly reported to the building principal or designee and documented appropriately. The school nurse shall also be informed and involved any time a student requires school-based nurse/health services as a result of an accident/injury.
